title: We're gonna need a lot more mathematicians
why_read: A discussion-provoking piece on how AI may reshape demand for mathematical skill, relevant to engineers thinking about AI's effect on technical labor markets.
analysis: This piece argues that as AI systems increasingly rely on and interact with formal mathematics, more people trained in mathematical reasoning will be needed to guide, verify, and extend these systems. It touches on real trends like AI-assisted theorem proving and formal verification becoming more central to software and AI development. The heavy comment count suggests it sparked debate, but the actual technical depth is likely thin, functioning more as an opinion piece than a rigorous analysis.
